name: watermelon-ui
title: Watermelon UI
responsibility: shadcn-compatible registry — the base UI kit (button, card, dialog, …) plus website-section blocks (hero, footer, pricing, bento, …). Expands the shadcn foundation.

upstream.notice: Full index (1073 items) in registry.json; individually fetched item snapshots in r/. Refresh any item: curl -s https://registry.watermelon.sh/r/<name>.json -o r/<name>.json

itemShape: shadcn registry-item: { name, type, dependencies[], registryDependencies[], files[{ path, content }] }. files[].content is raw upstream source; extract with python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('<item>.json'))['files'][0]['content'])"

resolution.@/components/ui/* and kit names (button,: shadcn base kit items — vendored to src/components/ui/

reachFor: The shadcn base kit for all standard UI (foundation tier)
Ready website sections when a block fits the design direction
avoid: Letting section blocks drive the design (principle 13: design first, library second)
inRepo: consumed by create-preset.py --wm; vendored files keep provenance headers
